comment: This repository is public and MIT. Every installed dependency's licence must be on this list, and a licence the checker cannot determine is reported as UNKNOWN, which is not on it — so it fails, as an undetermined licence should.

lightningcss.why: Weak, file-level copyleft rather than a permissive licence, so it is named here rather than allowed for everything. It arrives transitively under the bundler, is a development dependency, and no part of it is distributed with this application.

lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc.why: The prebuilt binary of the entry above, on this platform, and the same reasoning applies to it.
